note: Mechanical warnings (W1) for English copy. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions. A rule with 'max' warns only when it matches more than that many times. 'when' limits a rule to a project setting. Projects disable rules by id in config.json (lint.disable).

rules.message: Generic AI vocabulary. Use the plain verb.
Empty praise. Say what it does.

rules.pattern: in today's (?:fast-paced|digital|ever-changing) world|in the ever-evolving (?:landscape|world)|let's dive in|\bdive into\b|buckle up|look no further|at the end of the day
rules.message: Filler phrase. Start with the point.
'It's not just X, it's Y' reads as generated. State Y.
'Whether you're X or Y' is a template structure. Talk to one reader.
Robotic introduction. Start with the point.

rules.pattern: \b(?:thoughts|agree)\?|what do you think\?|drop a comment|let us know in the comments|tag a friend|share if you|like if you|smash that
rules.message: Engagement bait. Ask only a question worth answering.
More than one em dash. Use a full stop or a comma.
UK spelling in a US-English project.
